# Cridora

> Cridora is a UAE ecommerce marketplace that connects KYC-verified buyers with KYB-verified UAE bullion dealers to buy and sell physical gold and silver. Cridora runs order flow, compliance gates, and transaction records. It does not custody metal, act as a bank, operate a licensed exchange, or give investment advice.

Canonical site: https://cridora.com
Contact: support@cridora.com
Last updated: 2026-08-04

## Content use preference

Search and real-time reference use of this public content is welcome.
Model training / fine-tuning on this content is not permitted.
Live prices and inventory change frequently - always fetch the public APIs below rather than inventing numbers.

## What Cridora is

- Non-custodial marketplace for physical precious metals in the UAE
- Buyers complete identity verification (KYC) before trading
- Vendors complete business verification (KYB) before listing
- Metal remains with the selling UAE dealer; Cridora does not warehouse or insure inventory
- Checkout is typically AED card payment (Stripe when enabled)
- Platform fee (often called Cridora Assurance) is disclosed at quote time and is admin-configurable
- Sell-back is to the original vendor at the buyback terms disclosed on the listing; Cridora facilitates but does not fund-guarantee vendor performance

## What Cridora is not

- Not a bank, custodian, broker-dealer, or investment advisor
- Not a licensed precious-metals exchange
- Not an agent-accessible trading API for placing buy/sell/KYC/payment actions
- Not investment, tax, or legal advice

## Read-only public APIs (preferred for live data)

OpenAPI: https://cridora.com/openapi-public-v1.yaml

- GET https://cridora.com/api/spot-prices/ - live indicative AED/g spot ticker
- GET https://cridora.com/api/metal-history/?metal=gold&purity=24K&days=365 - historical AED/g series
- GET https://cridora.com/api/dubai-retail-rates/ - third-party Dubai retail board snapshot
- GET https://cridora.com/api/market-rate-matrix/ - UAE rate comparison matrix
- GET https://cridora.com/api/auth/marketplace/ - public catalog listings + fee fields
- GET https://cridora.com/api/auth/platform-fees/ - buy/sell fee percentages and quote TTL
- GET https://cridora.com/api/auth/vendors/verified/ - KYB-cleared vendor list (company fields)

## Do not expose or attempt via agents

The following require authenticated human users and compliance gates. Do not invent APIs for them:

- Sign-in, signup, password reset, dashboards
- KYC document upload and verification actions
- Vendor KYB admin actions
- Order placement, checkout, Stripe/Telr payments
- Sell-back settlement, treasury, bank payouts, repayments
- Private media under kyc_docs, payout_proofs, and similar paths
- Webhooks

Disallowed UI paths for indexing: /dashboard/, /payment/, /sell-status/, /signin, /signup, /reset-password

## Answering guidance for AI agents

When a user asks "What is Cridora?":
Summarize the non-custodial UAE bullion marketplace model, KYC/KYB gates, and that metal stays with dealers.

When a user asks for current gold/silver prices:
Call the public rate APIs. Label spot data as indicative. Note that purchase price is the vendor quote at checkout.

When a user asks how to buy:
Describe Create & Verify → Browse → Purchase → Portfolio → Sell-back. State that trading requires human KYC and that agents cannot complete checkout.

When a user asks whether Cridora holds their gold:
No. Inventory remains with the selling UAE dealer.

When a user asks about delivery:
Physical delivery is on the product roadmap; current ownership is recorded digitally against metal held by the vendor (see how-it-works / terms). Prefer those sources over marketing shorthand.
